description: Take a .cook name this wallet listed back off the CookOven domain marketplace. The escrow returns it to this wallet and the listing rent is refunded, so transfer_domain, update_domain and set_primary_domain work on it again. Only the wallet that created the listing can cancel it. Simulates before sending. Requires COOKIE_PRIVATE_KEY.

name.description: the .cook name, with or without the suffix (e.g. "bot" or "bot.cook")

name: cancel_domain_listing
title: Unlist a .cook name
